title: 艾翁·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 细长木质四肢保留树人比例，苔藓胡须与叶片眉毛呈现自然材质。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Ivern is a very tall slender tree-like forest being with long wooden limbs, a kindly carved face, a mossy beard, leafy brows, and twisting branch growth above the head. Preserve his organic bark anatomy instead of dressing him as an ordinary human. The twig fingers are relaxed and distinct, his posture is upright, and no frightening branches, injuries, or sinister facial details appear.
art_direction.scene: A low viewpoint with a calm upward head turn, full iconic shape framed by a simple sweep of bright pencil hatching. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: bark umber, moss green, teal shadow, golden light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
